percent-encoding-normalization.name: Percent-encoding case or normalization
percent-encoding-normalization.description: Differences in how userinfo is percent-encoded or normalized in authority

host-parsing-differences.name: Host parsing differences
host-parsing-differences.description: Divergent parsing of IP addresses, domains, or internationalized domains in authority

userinfo-port-extraction.name: Userinfo or port extraction differences
userinfo-port-extraction.description: One parser includes userinfo or port in authority, while other extracts only host, or one fails to parse.

scheme-vs-authority.name: Scheme parsed as authority
scheme-vs-authority.description: One parser returns scheme value in authority field; other correctly parses authority.

authority-host-userinfo-confusion.name: Authority Host Userinfo Confusion
authority-host-userinfo-confusion.description: Userinfo parsed as part of authority differently—@ ambiguity or userinfo/host boundary

control-char-stripping.name: Control character stripping in authority
control-char-stripping.description: One parser strips control characters from authority; the other preserves them percent-encoded.

host-case-normalization.name: Host case normalization
host-case-normalization.description: One parser lowercases the host; the other preserves original case or normalizes differently.

scheme-in-authority.name: Scheme appended to or mixed in authority
scheme-in-authority.description: One parser appends the scheme to authority field or one parser returns authority-only while other includes scheme prefix.

punycode-encoding-differences.name: Punycode encoding differences
punycode-encoding-differences.description: One parser applies punycode (xn--) encoding to internationalized domain names; the other preserves raw unicode.

port-stripping-from-authority.name: Port stripping from authority
port-stripping-from-authority.description: One parser strips port from authority field; the other includes it, or one normalizes port representation (leading zeros, removal of default ports).
